$comment: Template for adding a historical postmortem failure to eku_store/evidence/historical_failures.json
title: Short descriptive title of the bug / race condition / leak
originalAssumption: Flawed design assumption that caused the vulnerability under stress.
triggeringCondition: Specific operational or environmental trigger (e.g. clock drift, unhandled SIGKILL, storage saturation).
observedFailure: Symptom or catastrophic failure mode observed in production or testing.
failureMechanism: Detailed breakdown of the root cause mechanism.
preventionContract: Mandatory invariant required to prevent recurrence.
